entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of junk.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into that for you. To best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault! This thing is absolute garbage. The heart rate is either 50 or 180, there's no in-between. Look, I don't have time to play games with it. I just want my money back.
I understand your frustration completely. Since it sounds like a potential defect, our standard process is to connect you with our Technical Support team. They can help verify the issue and...

No! I'm not being passed around to another department. I don't want support, I don't want a replacement. I want a refund! Are you going to process my refund or do I need to speak to your manager and light up your company on Twitter?
Okay, no, that won't be necessary. I understand you're upset. Let me just pull up your order and review the return eligibility for you. One moment, please.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I'm looking at your order now... it shows it was delivered 20 days ago. And let me just check our policy... okay, I see here that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
So you can do it then? Just give me the refund.

Yes, since you're well within the 90-day window, I can go ahead and authorize that return for a full refund for you. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Fine. About time. Just make sure the email comes through.
It has been sent. Once we receive the band back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else I could assist with?
